title: Run of local conditional steps
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set and let a constraint satisfaction instance have variable set $V$. Given a finite list of variables and an initial local conditional expectation state, the run applies the local conditional step successively to the variables in list order and returns the resulting state; for an empty list it returns the initial state.
